question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 B 组：卡塔尔 vs 瑞士（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Qatar vs Switzerland (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 470 分叠加卡塔尔赛前低迷，瑞士约 82% 大概率取胜，平局仍留约 13.5% 空间。
one_liner_en: A 470-point Elo gap plus Qatar's poor pre-tournament form puts Switzerland at ~82% to win, with the draw still around 13.5%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 评分 1891 vs 1421（差 470 分），Davidson 模型给出瑞士约 80% 的基准胜率
key_reasons.en: Elo ratings 1891 vs 1421 (470-point gap); the Davidson model yields a ~80% baseline win probability for Switzerland

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士预选赛 4 胜 2 平不败、6 场仅失 2 球，且无重大伤停，扎卡第 4 次连续出战世界杯
key_reasons.en: Switzerland went unbeaten in qualifying (W4 D2, 2 goals conceded in 6) with no notable absentees; Xhaka makes his 4th straight World Cup

key_reasons.cn: 卡塔尔近 4 场正式比赛输 3 场，2025 阿拉伯杯小组出局（0-3 负突尼斯）
key_reasons.en: Qatar lost 3 of their last 4 competitive matches and exited the 2025 Arab Cup at the group stage (0-3 to Tunisia)

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 5.4/14.5/80.1; bounded evidence adjustment of ~1.9pp toward Switzerland (full-strength squad, solid qualifying defence vs Qatar's form slump), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
